pages.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving turkey stands with its tail feathers spread across this printable coloring page, showing two planted feet, layered wings, and a rounded beak. Long feather panels surround the broad body, while the curved neck and hanging wattle define the face. One small autumn leaf rests beside the bird.

pages.title: Happy Thanksgiving Coloring Page
pages.description: Happy Thanksgiving lettering fills this printable coloring page, with rounded outline letters, a large maple leaf above the greeting, and a pumpkin underneath the words. Two smaller leaves sit beside the pumpkin. Wide letter interiors and the pumpkin's curved panels form the main areas of this seasonal coloring sheet.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Cornucopia Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving cornucopia spills harvest produce across this printable coloring page, with a large pumpkin, an ear of corn, grapes, a pear, and two apples. The basket curves upward behind the food and has a broad woven rim. Fruit outlines and husk leaves separate the open shapes in the arrangement.

pages.title: Family Thanksgiving Dinner Coloring Page
pages.description: Two adults stand behind two children at a Thanksgiving dinner table in this printable coloring page, with a roast turkey centered between bowls and a pie. Hands rest on shoulders and along the table edge. The lattice pie crust, serving dishes, clothing, and hanging tablecloth create separate sections throughout the family scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Pumpkin Pie Coloring Page
pages.description: A pumpkin pie and a separate cream-topped slice appear in this printable coloring page, with a small pumpkin beside the plate and a wedge missing from the pie. The scalloped crust surrounds a broad filling area. Curved cream layers, pastry edges, and pumpkin panels add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pilgrim Children Coloring Page
pages.description: Two pilgrim children stand beside a harvest basket in this printable coloring page, wearing a buckled hat, a bonnet, traditional clothing, and broad buckle shoes. The boy rests one hand at his belt while the girl folds her hands. A pumpkin, corn, and an apple sit inside the basket's curved handle.

pages.title: Mayflower Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mayflower ship sails over two curved wave lines in this printable coloring page, with three masts, broad sails, small flags, and an extended bowsprit. Rectangular windows run along the hull beneath the rigging. Large sail panels contrast with the rope ladders and narrow wooden sections of the ship.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Parade Coloring Page
pages.description: A giant turkey balloon floats above a Thanksgiving parade in this printable coloring page, guided by two children in marching uniforms holding long tether lines. The balloon wears a pilgrim hat and has a wide feather fan. Small spectators, a street barrier, trees, and building outlines provide a simple setting.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Football Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy holds an American football while a girl waits to receive it in this printable coloring page, with two Thanksgiving pumpkins beside the playing area. Their shirts show a turkey and a maple leaf. Bent arms, planted shoes, football laces, and open pumpkin sections distinguish the two figures and nearby objects.

pages.title: Thankful Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A thankful tree spreads large blank leaves across this printable coloring page, with a smiling trunk, branching limbs, spreading roots, and fallen leaves underneath it. The leaf interiors remain open without words or patterns. Thick outer contours and a few trunk lines separate the tree's broad shapes in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Give Thanks Coloring Page
pages.description: Give Thanks lettering appears above a wheat sprig in this printable coloring page, with two large autumn leaves arranged beside the curved stem and grain shapes. The two words use rounded, hollow letters with open interiors. Leaf veins and the overlapping wheat sections add smaller details below the broad greeting.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Prayer Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy presses his hands together in prayer in this printable coloring page, standing beside a Thanksgiving table with a bread basket and a pumpkin. His eyes are closed and both shoes rest on the ground. Folded sleeves, a draped tablecloth, basket lines, and pumpkin sections complete the simple scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Gnome Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving gnome holds a pumpkin with both hands in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall curved hat, a wide belt, and rounded boots. A leaf and buckle decorate the hat above his curled moustache and beard. The pumpkin's broad panels contrast with the fingers, clothing edges, and small grass tufts.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Scarecrow Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving scarecrow stands on a wooden support in this printable coloring page, with straw hands, patchwork overalls, a floppy hat, and a stitched face. A pumpkin and sunflower sit beside the pole. Shirt checks, round buttons, outlined patches, and the flower's broad petals divide the harvest scene into distinct shapes.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: Three Thanksgiving pumpkins form a simple harvest arrangement in this printable coloring page, with one tall pumpkin behind two rounder pumpkins and an autumn leaf below. Each pumpkin has a curved stem and broad vertical sections. The overlapping outlines distinguish the separate shapes while leaving their interiors largely open.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Corn Coloring Page
pages.description: Two smiling ears of corn fill this printable coloring page, with peeled-back husks, large rounded kernels, curved leaves, and small grass tufts near their bases. One cob stands upright while the other leans diagonally. The husk panels and kernel rows provide different-sized areas within the simple Thanksgiving coloring sheet.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Three autumn leaves spread across this printable coloring page, with a large maple leaf above a rounded oak leaf and a smaller pointed birch leaf. Each leaf has a separate stem and clear branching veins. Their different edges create distinct silhouettes, while the broad interiors remain open for coloring.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Acorns Coloring Page
pages.description: Three smiling acorns appear in this printable coloring page, each with a rounded face, a scalloped cap, a short stem, and a pointed lower tip. A large oak leaf rests beneath the group. Curving cap patterns and simple facial outlines add details around the broad shapes of this Thanksgiving coloring sheet.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving wreath circles an open center in this printable coloring page, combining broad autumn leaves with two acorns and a pumpkin at the bottom. Pointed maple leaves alternate with rounded oak leaves and smaller leaf shapes. Veins, acorn caps, and curved pumpkin panels create separate details around the ring.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Harvest Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving harvest basket holds a pumpkin, an apple, a squash, and an ear of corn in this printable coloring page, beneath one large arched handle. The basket's rim and broad woven sections surround the produce. Open husk leaves, fruit outlines, and a few grass tufts distinguish the separate parts.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Sunflowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Three sunflowers rise from a plain vase in this printable coloring page, with broad pointed petals, open center disks, branching stems, and two large leaves. Small outlined seeds sit inside the flower centers. The rounded vase and wide leaf areas contrast with the repeated petals in this Thanksgiving coloring sheet.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Apple Pie Coloring Page
pages.description: A lattice-topped apple pie sits on a plate in this printable coloring page, with a whole apple and a cut apple half arranged in front. Broad pastry strips cross the filling beneath a scalloped crust. Two outlined seeds, a curved stem, and a single leaf add details around the fruit.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Roast Turkey Coloring Page
pages.description: A roast Thanksgiving turkey rests on an oval platter in this printable coloring page, with two drumsticks, folded wings, a carrot, a potato, and a leafy sprig. Curved lines mark the broad body and serving plate. The vegetables and garnish provide smaller shapes around the large central holiday dish.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Bread Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving bread basket holds six round dinner rolls in this printable coloring page, with a folded cloth draped over its rim and down the front. Curved marks distinguish the tops of the overlapping rolls. The basket's broad woven bands and twisted rim add smaller sections beneath the open bread shapes.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Table Setting Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving table setting fills this printable coloring page, with a large dinner plate between a fork, a knife, and a spoon, plus a folded napkin below. A pumpkin, two leaves, and a mug sit above the plate. Rounded dish outlines and long utensil handles create clear, separate coloring areas.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Baking Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman rolls dough while a girl stirs a mixing bowl in this printable coloring page, with a pumpkin, a pie pan, and eggs on the counter. Both figures wear aprons and hold their kitchen tools. The rolling pin, spoon, scalloped pastry edge, and overlapping ingredients define the Thanksgiving baking scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Wishbone Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving wishbone fills this printable coloring page, with two long curved arms, a rounded upper tip, a ribbon bow, and an oak leaf underneath. The bow wraps around the narrow upper section and has two pointed tails. Broad bone interiors contrast with the leaf veins and folded ribbon shapes.

pages.title: Pilgrim Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A pilgrim hat fills this printable coloring page, with a tall tapered crown, a broad oval brim, a plain hatband, and a large rectangular buckle. The upper ellipse gives the crown a simple curved shape. Wide blank panels remain between the bold outlines, with smaller enclosed areas inside the buckle.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Pumpkin Wagon Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy pulls a Thanksgiving pumpkin wagon in this printable coloring page, with three pumpkins in the wooden bed and one hand wrapped around the handle. He wears overalls, rolled cuffs, and broad shoes. The connected wagon wheels, plank edges, curved stems, and small grass tufts add details around the walking figure.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving mandala surrounds a central turkey in this printable coloring page, with repeated pumpkins, corn cobs, maple leaves, and smaller turkeys arranged in rings. Radial lines separate the motifs into broad sections. Feather fans, kernel grids, leaf veins, and pumpkin curves add varied details within the circular composition.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Chef Coloring Page
pages.description: A turkey chef carries a pumpkin pie in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall chef's hat and an apron with a large front pocket. Both wings support the pie beneath its scalloped crust and cream topping. Tail feathers, two planted feet, and small grass tufts complete the Thanksgiving character scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Playing Football Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving turkey holds an American football in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped jersey and a rounded helmet with a face guard around its beak. Its feather fan spreads behind the body while both feet remain planted. Jersey bands, football laces, and broad feather panels provide separate coloring sections.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Squirrel Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving squirrel holds a large acorn in this printable coloring page, with a curled bushy tail behind its body and a small pumpkin beside its feet. Both front paws wrap around the acorn beneath its scalloped cap. Broad ear interiors, belly outlines, and grass tufts complete the simple animal scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Owl Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving owl perches on a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, wearing a pilgrim hat with a wide brim, an outlined band, and a rectangular buckle. Two feet grip the pumpkin beneath its rounded body and folded wings. Scalloped chest feathers and an autumn leaf add smaller details below.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving cat sits beside a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, wearing a pilgrim hat with a broad brim, a simple band, and a rectangular buckle. Its tail curls upward behind the body while the front paws rest together. Whiskers, chest fur, toe lines, and grass tufts complete the outlined scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Dog Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving dog sits beside an ear of corn in this printable coloring page, with floppy ears, a wagging tail, and a neckerchief showing a turkey emblem. Its tongue extends from the open smile above four visible paws. Broad fur areas contrast with the neckerchief knot, corn kernels, and simple toe lines.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Unicorn Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving unicorn stands beside a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, with four outlined hooves, a single spiraled horn, pointed ears, and a flowing mane. Its long tail curves behind the body in broad sections. A small autumn leaf rests beside the pumpkin beneath the uncluttered character pose.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Farmers Market Coloring Page
pages.description: A vendor stands beneath a Thanksgiving farmers market canopy in this printable coloring page, with baskets of pumpkins, apples, and corn arranged below the counter. She wears a broad hat and apron, with both hands resting on the stall. Scalloped canopy edges and basket grids add details around the produce.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Hayride Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children ride on a hay wagon behind a tractor in this printable coloring page, waving while an adult drives past a barn, silo, and fence. The wagon connects to the tractor with a visible hitch. Outlined tires, straw tufts, clothing, and a nearby pumpkin distinguish the Thanksgiving hayride scene.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Food Drive Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children place canned food above an open donation box in this printable coloring page, with a pumpkin and a bag of apples on the Thanksgiving table. Both hold plain cans with their hands around the sides. Folded box flaps, a hanging tablecloth, tied bag ends, and outlined shoes complete the food-drive scene.

pages.title: Charlie Brown Thanksgiving Coloring Page
pages.description: Charlie Brown sits at a Thanksgiving table in this printable coloring page, with toast and popcorn on a plate beneath his resting hands and outlined zigzag shirt. His familiar hair curl and round head remain prominent above the table. Chair rails, tablecloth folds, socks, and shoes define the lower scene.

pages.title: Snoopy Thanksgiving Coloring Page
pages.description: Snoopy carries a Thanksgiving pumpkin pie in this printable coloring page, with Woodstock standing beside his feet and a few autumn leaves near the ground. The pie rests on a platter beneath a cream topping and scalloped crust. Snoopy's long ear, collar, rounded paws, and open body shapes remain clearly outlined.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Thanksgiving Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty holds an apple beside a Thanksgiving harvest basket in this printable coloring page, wearing an apron and a large bow above her mouthless face. Corn and fruit fill the basket beneath its arched handle. A pumpkin, fallen leaves, whiskers, and broad clothing panels add details around the standing character.

pages.title: Garfield Thanksgiving Coloring Page
pages.description: Garfield holds a platter of Thanksgiving roast turkey in this printable coloring page, wearing a pilgrim hat above his half-lidded eyes and broad rounded muzzle. His striped tail curls beside the seated body and large feet. Hollow stripe shapes, hatband edges, drumsticks, and platter rims provide separate areas throughout the scene.
